prompt.name: Reconnaissance Dité
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished 2D/2.5D fighting-game character sprite, ONE full body only, isolated on a truly transparent background. Single static neutral-ready pose facing screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view, head and feet both visible, feet on one common ground baseline. Portrait composition, complete silhouette with at least 5 percent transparent margin all round. Match the refined hand-painted game-sprite style and identity of the first standing figure in the reference, not the whole atlas. Clean solid outlines, precise material shading, readable anatomy and equipment attachments. Do not make a sprite sheet, pose variations, multiple characters, comparison layout, text, captions, UI, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, glow or atmospheric haze. The requested clothes are an original CQC costume, not an official released-game outfit. Preserve the same period-specific character and do not borrow another incarnation. BLADE WOLF / LQ-84i from Metal Gear Rising Revengeance, original Dité field-reconnaissance outfit “Reconnaissance Dité”. This is a mechanical QUADRUPED, not a humanoid or furry. Preserve the reference machine shape closely: exactly FOUR articulated clawed legs, silver teardrop body armor, angular RED sensor head/muzzle, long segmented robotic tail ending in an open manipulator claw, dorsal chainsaw module attached along the upper back. Keep all four paws clearly grounded, side-on facing right, coherent perspective and attachment points. Add bespoke matte olive-grey waterproof segmented field shell covers around upper torso, sealed seam gaskets, two LOW compact waterproof equipment panniers attached to the sides under the chainsaw rail, a small hard transparent optical weather shield over the existing red head sensors. Tail pivots, spine and chain mechanism remain unobstructed, no organic fabric fur, no hanging poncho, no extra paws. Strong readable machine silhouette with subtle dust/weathering only. ONE full machine, complete tail and claw within frame; wide portrait/landscape as needed.

visualReview.description: Quadruped LQ-84i with waterproof segmented covers, low panniers and accessible tail/chainsaw mechanics.
visualReview.note: Physically viewed: four grounded paws, preserved red angular sensor head with clear weather shield, low paired panniers, segmented waterproof shell, unobstructed dorsal chainsaw and raised manipulator tail.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC design; no claim of official outfit or exact recovered historical pixels. Anchor is preliminary and may be refined in catalogue QA.
